title: MISP core format event, restated
description: This repository's restatement of the MISP core format (draft-dulaunoy-misp-core-format) event: the members it names, in its own words.

id.description: identifier the instance gives the event, an unsigned integer as text

uuid.description: UUID of the event, kept for every update or transfer

published.description: true when the event is published

info.description: short human-readable summary of the event

threat_level_id.description: threat level: 1 high, 2 medium, 3 low, 4 undefined

date.description: reference date of the event, YYYY-MM-DD

timestamp.description: creation or last change of the event or its attributes, epoch seconds as text

publish_timestamp.description: time the event was published on the instance, epoch seconds as text

first_publication.description: time the event was first published by its creator, epoch seconds as text

org_id.description: identifier of the organisation that generated the event

orgc_id.description: identifier of the organisation that created the event

attribute_count.description: number of attributes, decimal as text

distribution.description: distribution level: 0 organisation, 1 community, 2 connected communities, 3 all, 4 sharing group

extends_uuid.description: UUID of the event this event extends

locked.description: true when remote edits by synchronisation are blocked

id.description: identifier the instance gives the organisation, an unsigned integer as text

uuid.description: UUID of the organisation, kept over time

id.description: identifier the instance gives the organisation, an unsigned integer as text

uuid.description: UUID of the organisation, kept over time

id.description: identifier the instance gives the attribute, an unsigned integer as text

event_id.description: identifier of the event holding the attribute

object_id.description: identifier of the object holding the attribute, 0 when none

object_relation.description: the attribute's relation within its object

type.description: attribute type, a value of the MISP type list

category.description: attribute category, a value of the MISP category list

to_ids.description: true when the attribute is meant for detection

distribution.description: distribution level: 0 organisation, 1 community, 2 connected communities, 3 all, 4 sharing group, 5 inherit from the event

timestamp.description: creation or last change, seconds since 1970-01-01 UTC as text

deleted.description: true when the attribute is soft-deleted

disable_correlation.description: true when correlation is turned off

data.description: base64 content, for malware samples and attachments

first_seen.description: first time the value was seen, ISO 8601

last_seen.description: last time the value was seen, ISO 8601

name.description: tag name, usually a taxonomy machine tag

exportable.description: true when the tag is exported

meta-category.description: meta category of the object template
